title: Production API did not respond for at least seven minutes
location: backend/index.ts:412-416 (startup refuses to listen if isolation check fails)
steps: From the audit sandbox, GET https://nodbusiness-backend-9psf.onrender.com/health at 22:37, 22:39 and 22:42 UTC on 2026-11-05 (timeouts 90 s, 180 s, 120 s).
expected: /health answers 200 within a few seconds (or within ~60 s on a free-tier cold start).
actual: All three requests connected and then received 0 bytes until the client timeout. The frontend on Vercel answered normally at the same time, so the API — which every signed-in feature depends on — was unavailable from this vantage point for at least 7 minutes.
impact: If this persisted, sign-in, feed, products, orders and messages fail for every user. Cause not determinable from outside: possible free-tier spin-up failure, a crash loop (index.ts exits when the database isolation check fails), a deploy in progress, or a regional network issue on the audit side.
fix: Owner: check Render events and logs for this window now. Then: move off the free plan (no sleep), add external uptime monitoring with alerting on /health, publish a status page, and make /health independent of slow dependencies. Re-test from a second network to rule out a vantage-point issue.
regression_test: External uptime check (1-minute interval) on /health with paging.
